title: VTC→FileNode guide: in-call file sharing
description: Section on sharing files during a call. Upload via JMAP blob upload, create FileNode, send as Chat Message with Attachment referencing the FileNode. Client rendering: file share notification in call UI. Download by other participants. Permission model: who can share (all participants vs moderator-only via VTCCallPolicy extension). Size limits. JSON examples of upload→FileNode→Message flow.
